en.text:
Today’s M&A briefing — 16 deals, the strategies behind them · 3 November 2026

🔹 Publicis Groupe (communication and marketing group with a proprietary data stack) finalizes the acquisition of LiveRamp (neutral first-party data aggregation and connectivity infrastructure for advertisers, publishers, and brands, USA) — $2.2bn.

🔹 BMF GRUP (property management and technical infrastructure, Romania) acquires Flash Lighting Services (design, implementation, and management of smart lighting systems) — more than €180m.

🔹 Frémy Transports (road transport, Lagadec group, Finistère, 110 employees, 115 engines) takes over Transports Codi (transport by dump trucks, flatbeds, tankers, and freight forwarding) — €2.5m.
Takeover following a judicial reorganization pronounced in 2025, on October 23.

🔹 Boluda Shipping (maritime transport and logistics) acquires Samskip (short sea shipping, a Finnish operator covering Scandinavia).

🔹 Gradiente SGR (fonds Gradiente III) (italian private equity fund, sectoral build-up strategy) finalizes the acquisition of groupe Agriforge (manufacturing of components for the agricultural sector).

🔹 Metriks AI S.p.A. Società Benefit (AI and digital transformation for businesses, Italy) takes a stake in 60 % de Lunghi Informatica S.r.l (ERP software publishing and IT services for SMEs, active).

🔹 Sportfive (international sports marketing agency, present in golf, football) acquires 4sports Hockey (representation of ice hockey athletes in European leagues and the NHL).

🔹 Artos Bakery Group (industrial bakery group operating chains such as Kamps and Bäckerei Schmidt, Germany) acquires Databites (specialized software publishing for bakeries).

🔹 Cuboid Self Storage (container self-storage, over 7,000 containers on more than 50 acres) acquires Safe Self Storage (container self-storage with land ownership, over 250 containers).

🔹 Windward (AI-powered maritime intelligence platform, based on AIS) acquires Azimut.ai (vessel identification by camera, optical recognition).

🔹 Lexit Group (digitalization and automation for production, logistics, retail) acquires Indicium (data capture, mobility, and network solutions, specialized).

🔹 Total Specific Solutions (TSS) (international group of specialized software, over 200 companies) acquires Twinfinity (real estate information management platform: centralization).

🔹 Conrad Electronic (b2B distribution of electronic components and technical products) acquires Hivebuy (automation of purchasing processes for businesses, Berlin startup).

➕ 3 more deals in the carousel.

🔹 Lexit Group (digitalisation et automatisation pour production, logistique) rachète Indicium (solutions de data capture, mobilité et réseaux, spécialisé).

🔹 Total Specific Solutions (TSS) (groupe international de logiciels spécialisés) rachète Twinfinity (plateforme de gestion de l'information immobilière : centralisation).

en.text:
Today’s fundraising briefing — 6 deals, the strategies behind them · 3 November 2026

🔹 Vera Health (medical search engine for healthcare professionals aggregating over 60 million scientific publications) — €29m.
Founded in 2024 by Taieb Bennani and Maxime Allouch (MIT and HEC Paris). Institutions (Yale, Columbia, American Heart Association) can integrate their own protocols. Approximately 40% of publications are open access, the rest via partnerships with publishers.
𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀: Expansion in Europe.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: Threshold Ventures (lead) ; Optum Ventures, Mantis VC, SV Angel ; reinvestments from Y Combinator and Gradient (Google's AI fund).
𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝘁𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗮𝘄𝗮𝘆𝘀:
→ Threshold Ventures leads; Google's Gradient and UnitedHealth's Optum Ventures sit alongside, pairing technology and health-system distribution backers.
→ About $3.3M median ARR (annual recurring revenue) and 80-120% growth; Vera Health has not disclosed its ARR.

🔹 Gallium Defense (drone detection radar, GDS-10 on AESA architecture with COTS components and software control) — €7.1m.
The GDS-10 has just passed outdoor testing. First orders are expected in Q1 2027. The stated goal is to meet 80% of the need for 20% of the price of a conventional radar.
𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀: Industrialization of the GDS-10 in two versions: critical infrastructure and armed forces.
𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝘁𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗮𝘄𝗮𝘆𝘀:
→ Keen Venture Partners and 360 Capital lead the €7.1M seed of a company founded in April 2026, according to Tech.eu and Vestbee.

🔹 Tumbleweed (modular orbital laboratories, Pods hosted on a free-flying orbital platform) — €6.9m · Seed.
Founded in 2024. The first Oasis Alpha mission launched aboard SpaceX Transporter-17 on July 7, 2026, carrying experiments for four clients — all first-time space users. The mission was fully booked one year before launch and paid in advance.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: PactVC (lead) ; Vanagon Ventures, Prototype Capital, EWOR and international investors.
𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝘁𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗮𝘄𝗮𝘆𝘀:
→ PactVC leads; Prototype Capital, an existing investor, returns alongside Vanagon Ventures and EWOR (tech.eu, Dealroom).
→ The deal is a seed funding the next vehicle, Oasis Beta, after a first mission flown on Transporter-17 on 7 July 2026 (Payload).
→ Four first-time space customers prepaid a mission booked a year ahead; the round of €6.9M is Austria's largest spacetech seed (tech.eu).

🔹 Conlio (automation of financial operations for road freight forwarders: freight document processing, settlement, payments) — €6.4m.

🔹 Roleo (AI job search agent for tech specialists: scans tens of thousands of offers) — €2.9m.

🔹 Granter (AI platform for identifying public funding, preparing application files, and managing funded projects after award) — €1.6m.

🔗 These deals and those of your markets, every morning: https://proplace.co/actualites/?lang=en&secteurs=healthtech-and-digital-health,space-tech,fintech,future-of-work-and-hr-tech,b2b-software-and-cloud

fr.text:
Levées de fonds : les 6 opérations chiffrées de l'édito du 3 novembre 2026.

🔹 Vera Health (𝑚𝑜𝑡𝑒𝑢𝑟 𝑑𝑒 𝑟𝑒𝑐ℎ𝑒𝑟𝑐ℎ𝑒 𝑚𝑒́𝑑𝑖𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑒 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑠𝑜𝑖𝑔𝑛𝑎𝑛𝑡𝑠 𝑎𝑔𝑟𝑒́𝑔𝑒𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝑝𝑙𝑢𝑠 𝑑𝑒 60 𝑚𝑖𝑙𝑙𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑝𝑢𝑏𝑙𝑖𝑐𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑠 𝑠𝑐𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑖𝑓𝑖𝑞𝑢𝑒𝑠) — 29 M€.
Fondée en 2024 par Taieb Bennani et Maxime Allouch (MIT et HEC Paris). Les établissements (Yale, Columbia, American Heart Association) peuvent intégrer leurs propres protocoles.
𝗢𝗯𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗳 : Expansion en Europe.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : La présence de Gradient (Google) et d'Optum (UnitedHealth Group) dans le tour dit quelque chose sur la lisibilité du modèle : l'un vient pour la technologie, l'autre pour la distribution dans les systèmes de santé.

🔹 Gallium Defense (𝑟𝑎𝑑𝑎𝑟 𝑑𝑒 𝑑𝑒́𝑡𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒 𝑑𝑟𝑜𝑛𝑒𝑠, 𝐺𝐷𝑆-10 𝑠𝑢𝑟 𝑎𝑟𝑐ℎ𝑖𝑡𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑢𝑟𝑒 𝐴𝐸𝑆𝐴 𝑎̀ 𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑝𝑜𝑠𝑎𝑛𝑡𝑠 𝐶𝑂𝑇𝑆 𝑒𝑡 𝑝𝑖𝑙𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑔𝑒 𝑙𝑜𝑔𝑖𝑐𝑖𝑒𝑙) — 7,1 M€.
Le GDS-10 vient de franchir l'étape des essais en extérieur. Les premières commandes sont prévues pour le premier trimestre 2027. L'objectif affiché est de répondre à 80 % du besoin pour 20 % du prix d'un radar conventionnel.
𝗢𝗯𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗳 : Industrialisation du GDS-10 en deux versions : infrastructures critiques et forces armées.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Un radar construit sur des composants de grande série devient déployable en nombre : c'est précisément ce que les armées cherchent face à la prolifération des drones — non pas un système parfait, mais une couverture dense à coût maîtrisé.

🔹 Tumbleweed (𝑙𝑎𝑏𝑜𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑜𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑠 𝑜𝑟𝑏𝑖𝑡𝑎𝑢𝑥 𝑚𝑜𝑑𝑢𝑙𝑎𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑠, 𝑃𝑜𝑑𝑠 ℎ𝑒́𝑏𝑒𝑟𝑔𝑒́𝑠 𝑠𝑢𝑟 𝑝𝑙𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑒 𝑒𝑛 𝑜𝑟𝑏𝑖𝑡𝑒 𝑙𝑖𝑏𝑟𝑒) — 6,9 M€ · Seed.
Fondée en 2024. La première mission Oasis Alpha a été lancée à bord du SpaceX Transporter-17 le 7 juillet 2026, transportant des expériences pour quatre clients — tous utilisateurs de l'espace pour la première fois.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Le fait que les quatre premiers clients aient payé d'avance et que la mission soit partie complète est le seul signal qui compte à ce stade.

🔹 Conlio (𝑎𝑢𝑡𝑜𝑚𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑠𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒𝑠 𝑜𝑝𝑒́𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑠 𝑓𝑖𝑛𝑎𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑒̀𝑟𝑒𝑠 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑚𝑖𝑠𝑠𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑛𝑎𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑡𝑟𝑎𝑛𝑠𝑝𝑜𝑟𝑡 𝑟𝑜𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑒𝑟 : 𝑡𝑟𝑎𝑖𝑡𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡 𝑑𝑒𝑠 𝑑𝑜𝑐𝑢𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑓𝑟𝑒𝑡, 𝑟𝑒̀𝑔𝑙𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡) — 6,4 M€.

🔹 Roleo (𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑡 𝐼𝐴 𝑑𝑒 𝑟𝑒𝑐ℎ𝑒𝑟𝑐ℎ𝑒 𝑑'𝑒𝑚𝑝𝑙𝑜𝑖 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑠𝑝𝑒́𝑐𝑖𝑎𝑙𝑖𝑠𝑡𝑒𝑠 𝑡𝑒𝑐ℎ𝑛𝑜𝑙𝑜𝑔𝑖𝑞𝑢𝑒𝑠 : 𝑠𝑐𝑎𝑛 𝑑𝑒 𝑑𝑖𝑧𝑎𝑖𝑛𝑒𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑚𝑖𝑙𝑙𝑖𝑒𝑟𝑠 𝑑'𝑜𝑓𝑓𝑟𝑒𝑠) — 2,9 M€.

🔹 Granter (𝑝𝑙𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑒 𝐼𝐴 𝑑'𝑖𝑑𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑖𝑓𝑖𝑐𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒𝑠 𝑓𝑖𝑛𝑎𝑛𝑐𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑠 𝑝𝑢𝑏𝑙𝑖𝑐𝑠) — 1,6 M€.
Le financement total de la société s'élève à 2 millions d'euros.
